description: Search brands in the public flexible packaging directories by keyword (brand name, category, packaging format such as "valve bag", "stand-up pouch", "compostable", or evidence text). Every keyword must match. Each result includes the observed packaging format, official evidence, official source URL, and observation date. Results never contain personal contacts or purchase-intent claims.

directory.description: Limit the search to one directory id from list_directories.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

locale.description: Response language: "en" for English or "zh" for Simplified Chinese.

offset.description: Number of matching results to skip, for pagination.

query.description: Keywords in English or Chinese. Leave empty to list every brand in scope.

name: search_brands
title: Search packaging brands
